purpose: Prevent bootstrap and status projections from becoming stale shadow authorities. Semantic owners remain authoritative; projections must point to owners, declare derivation, and fail CI when their freshness trails a projected owner.

CURRENT_SYSTEM.json.may_contain: release identity, owner references, bounded assurance summaries, current observation refs
CURRENT_SYSTEM.json.must_not_contain: a competing cognition state machine, host enforcement semantics that contradict HOST_PROFILES, or business authority copied from child domains

reconciliation_rule: When a semantic owner changes materially, all affected derived projections are updated in the same candidate or CI fails. A green owner change with a stale projection is not a valid promotion.
analogy: Controller-style reconciliation: desired semantic authority is owned once; projections are reconciled views, not competing sources of truth.
anti_bloat: Do not solve projection drift by adding another controller. Use static/reproducible reconciliation checks in the existing promotion gate.
